pause_selection: Earliest theta-qualified measured pause per animal, using the existing frozen cohort. Never select by coordination, replay content or stress results.
cell_selection: First eight frozen unit IDs in each selected bank; their documented LFP reference correspondence determines the theta covariate. This deliberately bounded development stress does not represent a fully calibrated biological procedure.
generator: Independent Poisson counts in every measured RUN bin, conditioned on the saved native LFP theta phase. Fixed evenly spaced cellular phase preferences, with a pi/2 POST preference change for even-numbered cells. Known generating intensities are retained; there are no inter-neuron interactions or replay-driven updates. PRE/POST behavior, support, clock gaps and finite-theta masks are the observed ones.
comparison: Apply the frozen cross-fitted joint-stratum rate adjustment and compare POST-minus-PRE coordination with the oracle residual endpoint using the exact generating intensity. Both use the identical counts, physical lag support and retained windows.
summary: For each animal and fixed neuron pair report Monte Carlo mean and standard deviation of fitted, oracle and fitted-minus-oracle endpoints. Bonferroni-correct a two-sided t interval across all animal-pair discrepancies in this fixed development family. This tests systematic nuisance bias, not biological significance or a full-procedure false-positive rate.
claim_boundary: No replay-order association, synaptic interpretation, animal-level biological inference, validation-bank completion or goal completion. Passing this single generator cannot replace the six mandatory full-procedure calibrations; failing it requires improving nuisance adjustment before those calibrations.
